## Lecture 2 — Ramsey model
Code to find the economy's transition from any initial capital stock to its balanced growth path. The economy here is normalized by productivity A and population L, so we look for the transition to the transformed economy's steady state. The code also generates a phase diagram with the saddle-path movement to the steady state.
- [MATLAB version: RamseyModel.m](RamseyModel.m){download=""}
- [Python version: RamseyModel.py](RamseyModel.py){download=""}

## LN4 — Real business cycle (RBC) models
This is the code for the core RBC model. The codes for impulse responses reproduces figures 1 and 2 in Lecture Notes 4. The code that includes simulations also simulates the model, shows a sample from the simulation, and reporduces the simulation part of table 1 in the lecture notes.
